evidence.per_route_limits: Variable per endpoint (e.g., 5 requests for some routes)
evidence.bucket_system: X-RateLimit-Bucket identifies shared limits across similar endpoints
evidence.emoji_routes_exception: Per-guild limits for emoji routes, quota may be inaccurate
evidence.cloudflare_bans: Invalid Request Limit triggers Cloudflare ban (distinct from API rate limits)
evidence.retry_after_header: Returned on 429 responses with seconds until reset

impact.description: Complex multi-tier rate limiting: global (50 req/s), per-route (variable), per-resource (channel/guild/webhook), and Cloudflare invalid request bans. Emoji routes have special per-guild limits. No published rate limit table; must parse headers dynamically. Selective discrimination against high-volume bots vs low-volume bots.

remediation.notes: Best practices: parse headers, exponential backoff, respect Retry-After, don't hardcode limits
